messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Natasha,

Raw Earth Recruitment's specialist focus on global mining talent makes this a relevant introduction for senior leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where mining growth depends on regulatory credibility, government relationships, stakeholder confidence, social licence and responsible development. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate assignments, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets alongside broader global mining opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
